📋 Security Policies
Password Policy
Min 8 chars Must include uppercase, number, symbol Change every 90 days No reuse of last 5 passwords
MFA Policy
TOTP (Google Auth) or SMS OTP Required for all admin accounts Reconfigure on new device Grace period: 48h max
API Key Policy
Rotate every 90 days Never share in client code Revoke immediately if exposed All usage logged
Data Handling Policy
No PHI in admin view All exports encrypted Delete data within 5 years per GH-DPA Right to erasure within 30 days
Access Revocation Policy
Immediate access termination on resignation Super Admin approval for role changes All revocations logged
📋 Emergency Procedures
📋 Platform Emergency Lock
SA only Takes platform offline for all users Used during breach, attack, or catastrophic failure Notifies all admins via SMS + email
📋 Emergency API Revocation
Immediately revoke all API keys Issue temporary read-only emergency keys Used when key compromise is suspected
📋 Breach Notification Protocol
Notify affected users within 72 hours per GH-DPA File report with Data Protection Commission Board + legal team briefing required

Human Anatomy Business Strategy Revenue opportunities and growth strategies for the interactive body map feature.
📋
Pharmaceutical Advertising
IBP Pharmacies can sponsor body-part pages. E.g. "Sponsored by HealthPlus" on the Heart page showing relevant OTC products and medications for cardiac health.
Revenue: ?5,000 — ?15,000/month per organ
📋
Specialist Referral Revenue
When a user taps a body part and views conditions, a "Find a Specialist" CTA shows nearby HCPs. Platform earns a referral fee per appointment booked via the anatomy feature.
?10 — ?50 per referral conversion
📋
Body-Part Targeted Campaigns
Marketing campaigns can now target users by body-part interaction. E.g. users who tapped "Lungs" ? show anti-smoking or asthma medication campaign. High-value precision targeting.
Premium marketing product
📋
Diagnostic Lab Integration
Body part tapped ? "Get tested" CTA ? partner labs offer discounted organ-specific test packages. Platform earns booking fee. E.g. Heart ? Lipid profile + ECG package.
Partnership revenue model
📋
Premium 3D Model Unlock
Free tier shows 2D static body map. Pro/Elite subscribers get full 3D interactive anatomy with detailed organ layers (muscle, bone, blood vessel views). Drives subscription upgrades.
Subscription upsell driver
📋
Public Health Campaigns (NGO/GHS)
Ghana Health Service and NGOs pay for featured health education campaigns anchored to body parts. E.g. NCD awareness on the Heart page. Creates institutional revenue stream.
Institutional/B2G revenue

📋 Getting Started
1. What is 4 Our Life and who is it for? —
4 Our Life is a comprehensive digital health platform designed for Ghanaians. It connects users with healthcare facilities, pharmacies, licensed healthcare professionals (HCPs), and wellness services all in one app. It is for individuals seeking health information, medication reminders, facility lookup, fitness tracking, period health management, and access to qualified HCPs. Businesses (IBPs) such as pharmacies, hospitals, and clinics can also register to reach our growing user base.
2. How do I create a 4 Our Life account? —
Download the 4 Our Life app from the Google Play Store or Apple App Store. Open the app and tap Create Account. Enter your phone number (used as your primary identifier), set a secure password, and verify via OTP sent to your number. Your unique platform ID (4OL-XXXXXX) is automatically assigned. You can start using the free plan immediately upgrade anytime for access to premium features.
3. What are the subscription plans and what's included? —
4 Our Life offers four plans: Free Basic health info, symptom checker, facility map, 1 medication reminder. Starter (?25/month) Up to 5 medication reminders, AI symptom checker, period tracker, fitness basics. Pro (?45/month) All Starter features plus AI Personal Trainer, medication enquiry, HCP messaging, BedTracker access. Elite (?89/month) All Pro features plus priority HCP consultations, family profile management, advanced AI analytics, and exclusive pharmacy deals. All paid plans auto-renew monthly. You can cancel or downgrade at any time from Settings.
📋 Account & Billing
4. What payment methods are accepted for subscriptions? —
We accept MTN Mobile Money (MoMo), Vodafone Cash, AirtelTigo Cash, and Debit/Credit Cards via Paystack. All payments are processed securely. For Mobile Money, you will receive a USSD prompt to authorise the payment. Subscriptions auto-renew monthly you will receive a reminder notification 3 days before renewal. You can manage payment methods in the app under Settings ? Subscription ? Payment Methods.
5. Can I get a refund if I accidentally subscribe or upgrade? —
Yes. Accidental purchases are eligible for a refund within 24 hours of the transaction, provided the premium features have not been significantly used. To request a refund, go to Settings ? Subscription ? Request Refund or contact support at support@4ourlife.com.gh. Refunds are processed within 3–5 business days back to the original payment method. Refunds are not available for renewals after the 24-hour window.
6. How do I delete my account? —
Per Google Play and App Store policies, account deletion is available through a web link. To delete your account: go to App Settings ? Privacy ? Delete Account, which opens a secure web form. Complete the form with your registered phone number and reason for deletion. You will receive a verification code. Once verified, your account enters a 30-day grace period during which you can cancel the deletion. After 30 days, all personal data is permanently deleted in line with the Ghana Data Protection Act (GH-DPA). You may also download your data before deletion. Note: Active subscriptions will be cancelled, and no refund is issued for unused subscription days.
📋 Health Features
7. How does the AI Symptom Checker work? —
The AI Symptom Checker uses a clinically-validated machine learning model trained on Ghanaian health data and ICD-11 disease classifications. Enter your symptoms using our guided input or free text, and the AI will suggest possible conditions ranked by likelihood, along with recommended next steps (self-care, visit a clinic, or seek emergency care). The Symptom Checker is not a diagnostic tool and should not replace professional medical advice. Results are stored in your health profile to assist HCPs during consultations. Accuracy is currently 96.4% for common conditions.
8. What is the BedTracker (PKM) feature? —
BedTracker (Patient Knowledge Management) is a real-time hospital bed availability system covering 1,287+ registered healthcare facilities across Ghana. It shows live bed counts by ward type (ICU, General, Maternity, Paediatric, etc.) and helps ambulance dispatchers and emergency services route patients to hospitals with available capacity. Users can check bed availability for a specific hospital before visiting. Ambulances connected to our platform receive automated routing suggestions powered by AI. Facilities update their bed data in real-time via the facility dashboard. BedTracker is available on Pro and Elite plans.
📋 Medication & Reminders
9. How do I set up medication reminders? —
Go to Health ? Medication Reminder ? + Add Medication. Search our drug database of 4,820+ medicines, select your medication, and enter your dosage, frequency, and schedule. The app will send push notifications at your set times. You can log whether you took the medication, which builds an adherence record accessible to your HCP. Free users get 1 reminder; Starter and above get up to 10. Elite users can manage family medication schedules. The AI Drug Interaction Checker automatically warns you if two of your logged medications have known interactions.
10. What is Medication Enquiry and how does it work? —
Medication Enquiry allows you to submit a prescription or medication request and receive real-time availability and pricing from registered pharmacies and IBPs near you. Simply upload your prescription or type the medication name, and within minutes you'll see a list of nearby pharmacies that have it in stock with prices for easy comparison. You can order for pickup or delivery (in supported areas). Payments for medication orders are processed through our secure escrow system funds are held until you confirm receipt. A small service fee applies to completed orders. This feature requires Starter plan or above.
📋 Facilities & Map
11. How do I find a nearby hospital, clinic, or pharmacy? —
Open the Map tab in the app. Your current GPS location is used to show all registered facilities within your area. You can filter by facility type (Hospital, Clinic, Pharmacy, Lab, CHPS), availability, distance, and ratings. Tap any facility to see its contact details, opening hours, services offered, real-time bed availability (for hospitals), and user reviews. Facilities with the blue ? badge are HEFRA-validated. The map is available to all users, including the free plan.
12. How do I register my healthcare facility on the platform? —
Healthcare facilities can register as an IBP (Institutional Business Partner) on 4 Our Life. Visit 4ourlife.com.gh/register-facility or contact our business team at ibp@4ourlife.com.gh. You will need to provide: facility name, type, GPS location, HEFRA registration number, contact details, and service offerings. Our team will verify your registration within 3–5 business days. Once approved, your facility appears on the map and is searchable by users. IBPs get access to a dedicated dashboard for managing availability, bookings, and marketing campaigns.
📋 Fitness
13. How does the AI Personal Trainer work? —
The AI Personal Trainer creates personalised workout plans based on your fitness goals (weight loss, muscle gain, endurance, flexibility), current fitness level, available equipment, and weekly schedule. It adapts your plan based on logged performance. You can also join live fitness challenges, earn FitCoins (redeemable for rewards), and connect with certified human trainers for premium guidance. The AI Trainer is available from the Pro plan. To get started: go to Fitness ? Set Up Profile ? Generate My Plan. Your plan updates every 2 weeks based on your progress logs.
📅 Period Tracker
14. How accurate is the Period Tracker prediction? —
The 4 Our Life AI Period Predictor v2 achieves 94.6% accuracy for next-period predictions with an average error of – 1.4 days, improving as it learns your personal cycle history. It predicts: next period date, fertile window, ovulation day, and current cycle phase. The more you log (period start/end, symptoms, flow intensity), the more accurate predictions become. For users with irregular cycles, the AI flags potential health concerns and suggests consulting an HCP. All cycle data is private, encrypted, and never shared without explicit consent. Period Tracker is available on all paid plans.
15. Can I opt out of period-related marketing notifications? —
Yes, absolutely. Marketing notifications related to the Period Tracker (pharmacy proximity alerts for period supplies, pain relief availability, etc.) are opt-in only. To manage preferences, go to Settings ? Notifications ? Marketing Preferences ? Period & Health Products. You can toggle off all marketing or choose specific types. Opting out does not affect your period reminders or AI predictions. Your cycle data is never sold to third parties and is only used for personalised, privacy-respecting notifications you've explicitly agreed to receive.
📋 FacilityScout
16. What is FacilityScout and how do I earn rewards? —
FacilityScout is our ground intelligence programme that allows app users to report unregistered healthcare facilities in their area. When you discover a hospital, pharmacy, clinic, or health centre not on 4 Our Life, you can submit its GPS location (10m radius accuracy), a photo of the building or signage, and an optional facility name. Our system checks if it's already registered. If it's new, a Field Collector visits the location to verify and register it. Once the facility is successfully registered on the platform, you receive a mobile data reward credited to your phone: Hospital (1GB), Pharmacy (500MB), Clinic (250MB), CHPS/Community (100MB). You can track up to 10 pending submissions and see their status in real-time from Explore ? FacilityScout ? My Submissions.
17. What happens if a facility I submitted already exists in the database? —
If the facility you submit matches an existing entry in our database (by GPS location match within 50 metres or name similarity), the submission will be marked as Duplicate and no reward will be issued. You will be notified in the app and can view the existing facility listing. Duplicate submissions do not count against your 10-submission limit. We recommend checking the facility map before submitting to avoid duplicates. If you believe a facility is incorrectly marked as a duplicate, you can raise a dispute through FacilityScout ? My Submissions ? Dispute.
📋 Privacy & Data
18. How does 4 Our Life protect my personal health data? —
4 Our Life is fully compliant with the Ghana Data Protection Act (GH-DPA) 2012. All personal and health data is encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3). Health data including cycle information, medication logs, and symptom records are processed only for personalising your experience and improving our AI models always in anonymised, aggregated form. Your data is never sold to third parties. You have the right to: access your data, download a full copy, correct inaccurate information, or request deletion at any time. We are registered with the Data Protection Commission of Ghana (DPC). For data queries, contact: privacy@4ourlife.com.gh.
19. How do I download a copy of my data? —
You can request a full data export at any time. Go to Settings ? Privacy ? Download My Data. You will receive an email/SMS link within 24 hours containing a downloadable archive of all your platform data including: profile details, health logs, medication reminders, cycle history, fitness records, transaction history, and chat messages. The file is encrypted and password-protected. The export link is valid for 72 hours. This feature is available to all users, including those on the free plan.
20. Can I contact a healthcare professional directly through the app? —
Yes. 4 Our Life has onboarded licensed Ghanaian Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) including doctors, pharmacists, nurses, and dietitians. Pro and Elite users can message HCPs directly through the platform's secure chat system, join HCP-moderated health groups, and request professional review of AI symptom results. HCPs are verified against Ghana Medical Association (GMA) and Pharmacy Council records before onboarding. All consultations through the platform are for informational guidance only and do not constitute a formal clinical consultation. In emergencies, always call 999 or visit your nearest A&E department.

BedTracker (PKM) Platform Design, UX & Business Strategy. This section outlines the recommended design approach and business model for the BedTracker feature.

📋 Design Principles

📋Emergency-First UI: Red/teal high-contrast palette. Critical alerts always visible. No animations that delay information display.
📋Hardware Dashboard (15" Tablet): Simplified large-tap UI for ward nurses. One-tap bed count update. Works offline with sync-on-connect.
📋Mobile App 2 Modes: Simple (public gender + age group ? nearby available facilities on map). Advanced (ambulance/HCP AI routing, ward filter, live capacity).
🗺️Map Visualisation: Green = beds available, Orange = low, Red = full. Pulsing red = active emergency reroute. Filters by ward type and region.
♿Accessibility: High contrast, large touch targets. Offline fallback for USSD / SMS queries in low-connectivity regions.

📋 Technical Architecture

⚡Real-Time: WebSocket connection from tablet dashboard to central server. Bed updates push to all connected clients <2s latency.
📋AI Routing Engine: When ward reaches 0 beds, AI identifies nearest available ward of same type across all facilities within GPS radius. Alert auto-sent to ambulances.
📋Tablet Hardware: 15" Android tablet + LTE SIM + dedicated BedTracker PWA. Fallback: SMS gateway (USSD code for low-connectivity). Monthly hardware lease or upfront purchase.
📋Data Security: Patient count only (no PII). Ward-level aggregation. HIPAA/GH Data Protection Act compliant.
📋API Integration: Ghana Health Service API, National Ambulance Service (NAS), NHIA Insurance, DHIMS2 interoperability.

📋 Business Model

📋SaaS Hospital Subscription: GH⭐ 00–2,000/month per facility (tier by bed count). Includes software, support, data analytics report.
📋Hardware Leasing: 15" tablet + LTE + mounting kit GH⭐ 00/month lease or GH⭐ ,500 upfront. Optional maintenance contract.
📋Emergency Services License: Annual license for National Ambulance Service & private ambulance operators. Tiered per unit count.
📋Data Analytics: Monthly occupancy reports for GHS, NHIA, donor orgs. Premium B2G data contracts.
📋Expansion: West Africa rollout (Nigeria, C — te d'Ivoire) after Ghana proof-of-concept. Partner with WHO & USAID for emerging market grants.
📋NHIA Integration: Pre-auth bed booking for insured patients. Reduces A&E bottlenecks, improves reimbursement accuracy.

📋 User Segments & Query Types

📋 Public Users
Simple inputs: Gender + Age group ? map shows nearest green hospitals. No account required. USSD fallback: *789#
📋 Ambulance / Emergency
Advanced: Ward type, patient condition, AI routing. Live GPS. Real-time reroute alerts pushed to all units.
📋 Facility Staff (Tablet)
One-tap bed count update per ward. Dashboard shows own facility + regional overview. Auto-sync every 5 min.
📋 Emergency Operators
Full dispatch screen: all ambulances, all facilities, case assignment, AI-suggested routing, audit trail.

📋 Automation & AI Features

📋Auto-Reroute: When ward = 0, AI finds nearest same-ward-type facility with availability and pushes to ambulances <30 seconds.
📋Alert Cascade: ICU Full ? push to all ambulances ? SMS to emergency ops ? in-app banner to admins. Escalates every 15 min until resolved.
📋Predictive Capacity: ML model predicts ward capacity crunch 4–6 hours ahead based on historical patterns (seasonal, disease outbreaks, holidays).
📋Audit Trail: Every bed update logged with timestamp, facility ID, ward type, staff ID. Compliance & quality reporting for GHS.

Jobs Feature Business Strategy Monetisation and growth opportunities for the platform's health jobs marketplace.
📋
Commission on Successful Placement
Charge a placement success fee (e.g. 5–10% of first month's salary) when a hire is confirmed through the platform. Facilities pay only when a hire is made low-risk incentive model.
Est. ?200 — ?500 per placement
🚀
Ministry of Health / GHS Partnership
Partner with the Ghana Health Service to manage postings for community health workers, CHPS postings, and public sector HCP deployment. Government contract for national health workforce matching.
B2G revenue stream
📋
HCP Training Upsell
When unemployed HCPs register, recommend platform-linked CPD courses and certifications that boost their hirability. Platform earns affiliate revenue from training partners (e.g. nursing colleges, GCPS).
CPD + Jobs bundle product
📋
Diaspora HCP Recruitment
Enable Ghanaian health professionals in the diaspora (UK, US, Canada) to apply for locum or permanent positions back home. Platform manages credential verification and relocation support coordination.
Premium diaspora product
📋
Health Workforce Analytics
Sell anonymised health workforce data reports to the Ministry of Health, NGOs, and international health organisations (WHO, USAID). Reports show supply/demand by specialty and region.
Data monetisation product
🏥
CHPS & Rural Zone Incentive
Partner with rural district health teams to incentivise HCP deployment to underserved areas. Platform facilitates application, onboarding, and ongoing remote support for HCPs in CHPS zones.
Social impact + grant revenue
